versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the game-vfx-mesh-workflow skill.
- Covers a full pipeline for implementing 2.5D VFX in Godot using mesh shells, scrolling textures, and engine animation.
- Details 631 color rule, 点线面 (point-line-surface) composition, and ink-wash grading for stylized effects.
- Includes Godot-specific shader, script, and layering patterns; provides best practices and anti-patterns gathered from production.
- Features setup checklists, asset references, and practical prompts for AI-generated seamless textures.
